dataset.name: keremberke/hard-hat-detection
dataset.license: CC BY 4.0 (as declared by the dataset card)
dataset.attribution: Hard Hats dataset by Roboflow Universe Projects; source project https://universe.roboflow.com/roboflow-universe-projects/hard-hats-fhbh5/dataset/2

manifest_validation.mapping: COCO category 0 hardhat -> Hardhat; category 1 no-hardhat -> NO-Hardhat; xywh -> xyxy

configuration.matching: descending-confidence greedy one-to-one; same class; IoU >= threshold

limitations: Dataset/model training-data overlap has not been ruled out; treat as a potentially overlapping benchmark.
Results cover only the evaluated classes and dataset; they are not PPE compliance or safety certification.

latency.timed_scope: detector call only; excludes dataset access, image decode, and evaluation matching
